data.description: Interior Designed | Brand New | Full Sea View
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is delighted to present to you this sea view 3-bedroom apartment in Ellington Beach House, Palm Jumeirah.

Property Details;

- Views of the Sea, Royal Atlantis, Frond Villas & Marina Skyline in the   distance
- Professionally interior designed
- x2 Parking spaces
- Never lived in before, brand new furnishings
- Fully fitted open plan kitchen
- 3 Bedroom + Maids Room
- BUA: 2,045.04 sq. ft

Ellington Beach House on Palm Jumeirah is a boutique-style residential development that redefines beachfront living in Dubai. Set on the prestigious East Crescent, this exclusive project by Ellington Properties offers a refined collection of one- to four-bedroom residences and penthouses, each designed with elegant interiors, bespoke finishes, and sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai’s skyline.

Blending modern architecture with resort-inspired living, Ellington Beach House provides direct private beach access, an infinity pool that stretches toward the horizon, state-of-the-art fitness and wellness facilities, and beautifully landscaped gardens for relaxation. Residents enjoy the comfort of world-class concierge services, a stylish lounge and clubhouse, and the privacy of a limited collection of homes within a serene setting.

This development combines timeless design with a coveted beachfront location, making it an ideal choice for discerning homeowners and investors seeking luxury, exclusivity, and the ultimate Palm Jumeirah lifestyle.

To book a viewing, please call our Sales Manager & Palm Jumeirah Specialist Mike for further details.

Address: Office # GR18, Golden Mile 8, Palm Jumeriah
